description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 30.10.2017 to 05.11.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
